bagPolicy.summary: Bring only one small bag: large bags are not permitted in the auditorium, the cloakroom is closed, and there is no bag storage. Belongings may be searched at entry.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The theatre has no car park; the closest listed parking is Q-Park Grand Canal Square on Chimney View.
